premises.text: Open Garden enables users to share mobile internet among devices.
premises.evidence_span: open garden is a mesh networking application that enables you to share your mobile internet among your phone tablet and laptop

premises.text: Crowdsourcing connectivity improves mobile internet speed and reliability.
premises.evidence_span: it works by crowdsourcing connectivity that means that when you install your application you also benefit from a faster mobile internet and more reliable mobile internet

premises.text: User stories demonstrate the application's effectiveness in various situations.
premises.evidence_span: a user just said on our website oh thanks to open garden i was able to watch hbo on my tablet during the hurricane in new york

premises.text: The application has been adopted by communities to enhance connectivity.
premises.evidence_span: a community of a hundred thousand farmers and entrepreneurs were given ten thousand android tablets and they started to use open garden to share and deploy mobile internet

premises.text: The number of installs indicates strong user interest and support.
premises.evidence_span: we have reached 2.5 million installs of our software

premises.text: A larger network improves connectivity for all users.
premises.evidence_span: the more people are on the open garden network the better connectivity we can all achieve together

value.text: Users benefit from improved mobile internet connectivity through sharing.
value.evidence_span: faster mobile internet and more reliable mobile internet

notes: Investor call and recruitment details excluded as traction.
